mapper.insert: INSERT INTO student_answer ( attempt_id, question_id, selected_option, answer_text, answer_image, answer_status, is_correct, awarded_marks ) VALUES ( #{attemptId}, #{questionId}, #{selectedOption}, #{answerText}, #{answerImage}, #{answerStatus}, #{isCorrect}, #{awardedMarks} )
mapper.update: UPDATE student_answer SET selected_option = #{selectedOption}, answer_text = #{answerText}, answer_image = #{answerImage}, answer_status = #{answerStatus}, is_correct = #{isCorrect}, awarded_marks = #{awardedMarks} WHERE answer_id = #{answerId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO student_answer ( attempt_id, question_id, selected_option, answer_text, answer_image, answer_status, is_correct, awarded_marks ) VALUES ( #{attemptId}, #{questionId}, #{selectedOption}, #{answerText}, #{answerImage}, #{answerStatus}, #{isCorrect}, #{awardedMarks} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE selected_option = VALUES(selected_option), answer_text = VALUES(answer_text), answer_image = VALUES(answer_image), answer_status = VALUES(answer_status), is_correct = VALUES(is_correct), awarded_marks = VALUES(awarded_marks)

INSERT INTO student_answer ( attempt_id, question_id, selected_option, answer_text, answer_image, answer_status, is_correct, awarded_marks ) VALUES
( #{item.attemptId}, #{item.questionId}, #{item.selectedOption}, #{item.answerText}, #{item.answerImage}, #{item.answerStatus}, #{item.isCorrect}, #{item.awardedMarks} )
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE selected_option = VALUES(selected_option), answer_text = VALUES(answer_text), answer_image = VALUES(answer_image), answer_status = VALUES(answer_status), is_correct = VALUES(is_correct), awarded_marks = VALUES(awarded_marks)
mapper.select: SELECT answer_id, attempt_id, question_id, selected_option, answer_text, answer_image, answer_status, is_correct, awarded_marks FROM student_answer WHERE attempt_id = #{attemptId} AND question_id = #{questionId} LIMIT 1

SELECT answer_id, attempt_id, question_id, selected_option, answer_text, answer_image, answer_status, is_correct, awarded_marks FROM student_answer WHERE attempt_id = #{attemptId} ORDER BY answer_id ASC

SELECT q.question_id, q.question_type, q.question_text, q.question_image, q.option_a, q.option_b, q.option_c, q.option_d, sa.selected_option, sa.answer_text, sa.answer_image, COALESCE(sa.answer_status, 'UNANSWERED') AS answer_status, q.correct_option, q.reference_answer, q.explanation, COALESCE(sa.is_correct, 0) AS is_correct, COALESCE(sa.awarded_marks, 0) AS awarded_marks, q.marks FROM question q INNER JOIN quiz_attempt qa ON q.quiz_id = qa.quiz_id LEFT JOIN student_answer sa ON sa.question_id = q.question_id AND sa.attempt_id = qa.attempt_id WHERE qa.attempt_id = #{attemptId} ORDER BY q.question_id ASC
